# Agent Protocol

> API Reference documentation generated by Sourcey.

## API Reference

- [Agent Protocol](/api.html): 27 documented operations
- [Search Agents](/api.html#operation-agents-search-post): POST /agents/search - List Agents available in this service.
- [Get Agent](/api.html#operation-agents-agent-id-get): GET /agents/{agent_id} - Get an agent by ID.
- [Get Agent Schemas](/api.html#operation-agents-agent-id-schemas-get): GET /agents/{agent_id}/schemas - Get an agent's schemas by ID.
- [Create Thread](/api.html#operation-threads-post): POST /threads - Create a thread.
- [Search Threads](/api.html#operation-threads-search-post): POST /threads/search - Search for threads.
- [Get Thread History](/api.html#operation-threads-thread-id-history-get): GET /threads/{thread_id}/history - Get all past states for a thread.
- [Copy Thread](/api.html#operation-threads-thread-id-copy-post): POST /threads/{thread_id}/copy - Create a new thread with a copy of the state and checkpoints from an existing thread.
- [Get Thread](/api.html#operation-threads-thread-id-get): GET /threads/{thread_id} - Get a thread by ID.
- [Delete Thread](/api.html#operation-threads-thread-id-delete): DELETE /threads/{thread_id} - Delete a thread by ID.
- [Patch Thread](/api.html#operation-threads-thread-id-patch): PATCH /threads/{thread_id} - Update a thread.
- [Search Runs](/api.html#operation-runs-search-post): POST /runs/search - List runs for a thread, agent or status
- [Get Run](/api.html#operation-runs-run-id-get): GET /runs/{run_id} - Get a run by ID.
- [Delete Run](/api.html#operation-runs-run-id-delete): DELETE /runs/{run_id} - Delete a run by ID.
- [Wait for Run output](/api.html#operation-runs-run-id-wait-get): GET /runs/{run_id}/wait - Wait for a run to finish, return the final output. If the run already finished, returns its final output immediately.
- [Stream output from Run](/api.html#operation-runs-run-id-stream-get): GET /runs/{run_id}/stream - Join the output stream of an existing run. This endpoint streams output in real-time from a run similar to the /threads/__THREAD_ID__/runs/stream endpoint. Only output produced after this endpoint is called will be streamed.
- [Cancel Run](/api.html#operation-runs-run-id-cancel-post): POST /runs/{run_id}/cancel
- [Create Background Run](/api.html#operation-runs-post): POST /runs - Create a run in a new thread, return the run ID immediately. Don't wait for the final run output.
- [Create Run, Stream Output](/api.html#operation-runs-stream-post): POST /runs/stream - Create a run in a new thread, stream the output.
- [Create Run, Wait for Output](/api.html#operation-runs-wait-post): POST /runs/wait - Create a run in a new thread. Wait for the final output and then return it.
- [Open Thread WebSocket Stream](/api.html#operation-threads-thread-id-stream-get): GET /threads/{thread_id}/stream - Upgrade to a WebSocket connection for a thread. After the connection is upgraded, clients send streaming protocol commands in-band and receive command responses plus unsolicited events on the same connection. Use `subscription.subscribe`, `subscription.unsubscribe`, and `subscription.reconnect` to manage event filters on the WebSocket.
- [Open Thread SSE Stream](/api.html#operation-threads-thread-id-stream-post): POST /threads/{thread_id}/stream - Open a connection-scoped Server-Sent Events stream for a thread. The request body selects channels, namespace prefixes, optional namespace depth, and an optional sequence number to replay buffered events after. Closing the HTTP connection unsubscribes from this stream.
- [Send Thread Streaming Command](/api.html#operation-threads-thread-id-commands-post): POST /threads/{thread_id}/commands - Send a streaming protocol command to a thread over HTTP. This endpoint is the request/response companion to the SSE event stream and supports commands such as `run.start`, `input.respond`, `input.inject`, `state.get`, `state.listCheckpoints`, and `state.fork`.
- [Get Store Item](/api.html#operation-store-items-get): GET /store/items
- [Insert or Update Item](/api.html#operation-store-items-put): PUT /store/items
- [Delete Store Item](/api.html#operation-store-items-delete): DELETE /store/items
- [Search Store Items](/api.html#operation-store-items-search-post): POST /store/items/search
- [List namespaces](/api.html#operation-store-namespaces-post): POST /store/namespaces
